voice.summary: Calmloop speaks softly to designers who are tired of loud interfaces. It is short, polite and technical when it needs to be, and never uses a shout to make a point.
dos: Describe motion in plain terms: slow, steady, soft
donts: Do not describe a spinner as 'delightful'

taglines: A calm moment while it loads
boilerplate: Calmloop is a UI kit of six calm orbiting-dot loaders with shared controls for speed, size and colour.

microcopy.success: Copied. Paste it into your project.
microcopy.error: Speed must be between 0.5 and 3. Try again.
microcopy.empty: No loaders match. Clear the filter.

logo.note: Orbiting dots are both the product and its mood.
